### In the Bosom of the Shepherd
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/bosom-shepherd
Passage: Isaiah 40:11
Points:
- Human beings resemble straying sheep who cannot right themselves without outside rescue.
- God promised the Babylonian exiles that their sin and affliction had not broken His covenant.
- The Lord provides general leadership for His people while caring tenderly for individual weaknesses.
- In Christ, the Shepherd took on human nature and intimately empathizes with our struggles.
- Believers can pray with confidence knowing their daily burdens are never trivial to Him.

### How to Get God’s Power in Your Life
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-april-24-2024.html
Passage: Isaiah 40:29
Points:
- Persistent weariness usually indicates an individual is trying to live on self-effort alone.
- An appliance disconnected from a socket is useless, and humans without God lose their real purpose.
- Scriptural empowerment is divine and supernatural, not mere self-help or positive thinking.
- The indwelling Holy Spirit supplies strength to face pressure, loneliness, rejection, and grief.
- Christ offers this renewal every day to anyone who trusts in Him.

### Trusting God for Comfort in Weary Seasons
Author: Melissa Spoelstra
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-june-1-2022.html
Passage: Isaiah 40:31
Points:
- Hectic schedules and frustration often tempt believers to soothe themselves with empty escapes.
- Ancient Israel falsely assumed that God had grown weary or had forgotten their plight.
- Isaiah reminded the people that the Creator never tires and possesses boundless understanding.
- Shifting attention away from counterfeit comforts to wait on the Lord restores the inner soul.
- Enlarging our perspective of God produces lasting spiritual transformation rather than superficial habit changes.

### The Good Shepherd
Author: Mary Southerland
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-may-24-2019.html
Passage: Isaiah 40:11
Points:
- Sheep are fragile and prone to panic, requiring continuous watchfulness and shelter from a shepherd.
- A true shepherd does not push or drive his animals harshly, but walks ahead and calls them gently.
- Stubborn self-will frequently causes believers to stray into dark places and distress.
- Jesus demonstrated the ultimate shepherd's love by sacrificing His life for flawed, broken sheep.
- Continually seeking His plan and listening to His guidance dispels anxiety and isolation.
